newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - SoundView starts disk drive makers.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - SoundView starts disk drive makers.

text.p: -- SoundView Financial Group Inc said analyst Mark Specker it initiated coverage of Quantum Corp, Seagate Technology Inc and Western Digital Corp with short-term buy and long-term hold ratings.
-- said it expects Quantum to earn $5.13 a share in fiscal 1998 and $5.73 a share in fiscal 1999. Set a three-month price target of $60 a share.
-- said it expects Seagate to earn $3.54 a share in fiscal 1997 and $4.72 a share in fiscal 1998. Set a six-month price target of $61 a share.
-- said expects Western Digital to earn $5.71 a share in fiscal 1997 and $7.86 a share in fiscal 1998. Set a six-month price target of $80 a share.
-- Western Digital was trading up 2-1/2 at 66-1/4, Seagate Technology was trading up 1-1/2 at 50.
